definitions.explanation: A figure made of packed snow. Traditional Japanese snowmen are made of two stacked snowballs (not three as in Western style).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雪|ゆき}だるま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{雪|ゆき}だるま⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: There's a big snowman standing in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、{雪|ゆき}だるま⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}けて→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: It got warm and the snowman melted away.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow) + ⟦だるま→だるま：06539_daruma⟧ ({達磨|だるま}, Daruma doll). Named after the round shape of a Daruma doll.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese {雪|ゆき}だるま are made of two snowballs (head and body), unlike the Western three-ball snowman. The kanji form {雪達磨|ゆきだるま} exists but hiragana ⟦だるま→だるま：06539_daruma⟧ is standard.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {雪|ゆき}だるま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make a snowman)
- {雪|ゆき}だるま⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧ (a snowman melts)
- {雪|ゆき}だるま{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ (to snowball, to increase rapidly — idiomatic)
